review_method: Read source text and source hashes only; no extractor/helper imports, self-check execution, raw-original reads, scientific replay or repository edits.

resolved_or_bounded_findings.finding: The extractor's strict six-source interpretation set included mr3_reach_runtime.py, but the first outer scope omitted that source.
resolved_or_bounded_findings.resolution: Root added the canonical runtime source with SHA256 3f1fac149adaadfe27197b538e73bbd149b04d28374c38106b26b762dc4e79dc. The resulting 78-entry scope includes it in outer actual-wait source_before/source_after. Extractor, runner and tested helper bodies did not change.

resolved_or_bounded_findings.initial_question: The driver has no timer/kill implementation and waits for submitted work until it is actually reaped.
resolved_or_bounded_findings.resolution: Root explicitly declares 240 seconds as a posthoc actual-parent-wait PASS fee gate, with a total 300-second reservation. This is not a hard timeout. The existing fee assertion raises into errors and makes passed false if the completed wait exceeds the declared main cap; the full actual fee remains recorded.
resolved_or_bounded_findings.limitation: Finite byte/line/metadata bounds and git-show subprocess timeouts are not a real-time completion guarantee. No additional hard-kill mechanism is assumed by this review.

resolved_or_bounded_findings.observation: valid_epoch_schema_rows and event_counts are incremented after envelope/summary validation, before all event-specific payload validation. A later robot/boolean error may therefore overlap those counters and parse_or_schema_error_count.
resolved_or_bounded_findings.interpretation: Do not sum valid_epoch_schema_rows and error_count as an exclusive row partition. all_rows_valid and absence_inference_from_event_counts_allowed are false when an error occurs. The full line count and full-file SHA still cover every consumed line. No result is interpreted here.
